q: Choose the correct comparative: John is ____ than Peter. (P3)
explain: When comparing two people or things, use the comparative '-er'.
hint: Comparing two items requires the '-er' suffix.

q: Choose the correct superlative: Mount Everest is the ____ mountain in the world. (P3)
explain: Superlative form '-est' is used for the extreme among three or more.
hint: Comparing all mountains requires the '-est' suffix.

q: Which word is an ADVERB (tells HOW an action is done)? (P3)
explain: Adverbs of manner often end in '-ly' (e.g. run quickly).
hint: Look for the word ending in '-ly' that describes an action.

q: Choose the correct conjunction: He was hungry ____ he ate some rice. (P3)
explain: 'So' introduces the logical result or consequence.

q: Choose the correct conjunction: She studied hard ____ she passed the test. (P3)
explain: 'And' connects two positive, related ideas.

q: Choose the correct homophone: The bird flew into the ____. (P3)
explain: 'Air' refers to the atmosphere that surrounds us.

q: Choose the correct homophone: Did you ____ that strange noise? (P3)
explain: 'Hear' (with 'ear') means to perceive sound.

q: Choose the correct pronoun: Mary and ____ are going to church. (P3)
explain: 'I' is the subjective pronoun used in compound subjects.
hint: Use the subject pronoun 'I', not object 'me'.

q: What is the past tense of 'RUN'? (P3)
explain: 'Run' is an irregular verb: run → ran.
hint: An irregular vowel change from 'u' to 'a'.

q: What is the past tense of 'GO'? (P3)
explain: 'Go' becomes 'went' in the simple past.

q: What is the past tense of 'BUY'? (P3)
explain: 'Buy' becomes 'bought' in the past tense.

q: Choose the correct contraction for 'do not': (P3)
explain: The apostrophe replaces the missing 'o': don't.
hint: The apostrophe goes where the letter 'o' was dropped.
